problem: Simultaneous development amplified GitHub Actions runner use because native PR and recovery-dispatched delivery could execute concurrently for the same PR, while repository-wide recovery also started on feature pushes.
root_cause: Required and BRAIN concurrency keys included github.event_name, splitting one logical PR flight into separate native and recovery groups. The recovery supervisor push trigger was repository-wide.

evidence.observed_pattern: same PR showed concurrent Required/BRAIN plus broad auxiliary fan-out and repeated feature-push supervisor executions
